item.description:
Hey there!

Thanks for checking out my corner of the web. I am a researcher and public interest technologist interested in finding ways to best leverage technology to improve outcomes for vulnerable populations.

I’ve worked in Europe, Africa, Asia, and Latin America solving challenges related to conflict, energy, migration, and humanitarian response. Currently, I am a graduate student at MIT, where I am studying Technology and Policy and Electrical Engineering / Computer Science.
